author: Mark Thompson
title: Lisa Cook: Fed Governor Defies Trump's Calls to Resign
text:
Trump Attempts to Oust Fed Governor Lisa cook, Sparking Legal Showdown The unprecedented attempt to remove Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook by former President Donald Trump has ignited a constitutional and legal battle, raising serious questions about the independence of the US central bank. Cook, the first Black woman to serve on the Fed’s Board of Governors, is refusing to step down, asserting that the president lacks the legal authority to dismiss her.
Mortgage Fraud Allegations Fuel the Conflict The dispute originated with allegations made by Bill Pulte, a trump appointee to the Federal Housing Finance Agency, who claimed on social media that Cook committed mortgage fraud in 2021. Pulte alleged Cook improperly designated properties in Ann Arbor, Michigan, and Atlanta, Georgia, as her primary residence to obtain more favorable mortgage terms – a practice that could lower interest rates.
Trump’s “Firing” and Cook’s Defiance Following Pulte’s accusations, Trump called for Cook’s resignation and subsequently announced her immediate removal via a post on his Truth Social platform. He cited her alleged “deceitful and potentially criminal conduct” as justification for her dismissal.However, Cook and her legal team swiftly countered, arguing that the president’s actions “lack any proper process, basis or legal authority.”
